verdict.rationale: Intuit Intelligence chat accepts natural-language instructions to create invoices, resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports and estimate tax savings, and answers free-form questions like "What's driving my profit?" (docs-19, docs-20, docs-29). The AI invoice generator drafts invoices for review (docs-12), and Intuit's official MCP server exposes 145 tools with full CRUD, so external LLM agents can also drive the product conversationally (gh-3, gh-4, probe-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the chat reliably executes these commands, and in-depth documentation of the chat's command scope and limits beyond marketing one-liners.
